ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Weather its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Recording weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Interpreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Transporting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Soil and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
